reason: Function search: a query that names an area of the language shows that area's line above the results (its status and evidence, web/coverage-areas.mts). The area rows themselves are only in the lazy docs-upstream-<mode>.json files, never in the CLI. cli/pyjs.cjs grows by what it embeds: the notebook page (web/index.html with web/docsearch.ts: the area line, its Request link and WebMCP's area line) and the catalog, whose MATLAB entries gain the area tags their mapping selects (catalog/matlab/absent.json).
